data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (destination with suggestion, dates, rooms/guests, search, then sort by price) with the right parameters, but it adds an unneeded 'Stays' sidebar step, adds children and ages, and treats sort as optional; it also leaves out the distance/filter step and the order of search and guests, so a browser automation could be built but would be somewhat off.
